class.name: Serde
class.brief_description: Abstract base for resources that round-trip through a [PackedByteArray].
class.description: [Serde] keeps payload types responsible for their own byte representation. Callers can pass the result of [method serialize] across the wire or store it for a later [method deserialize]. [codeblock] var bytes := payload.serialize() copy.deserialize(bytes) [/codeblock] A subclass supplies the representation by overriding [method _serialize] and [method _deserialize], and callers always use the plain [method serialize] and [method deserialize] pair. The two spellings are one contract: the plain verb returns the override when a script supplies one and falls back to the native implementation otherwise, so the caller never asks which kind of subclass it holds. [DictionaryRecord] is the implementation this addon ships.

method.name: _deserialize
method.description: Repopulates this resource from [param bytes], undoing [method _serialize]. Override it in a script subclass; [method deserialize] is what callers use.

method.name: _serialize
method.description: Converts this resource to a [PackedByteArray]. Override it in a script subclass; [method serialize] is what callers use.

method.name: deserialize
method.description: Repopulates this resource from [param bytes]. A subclass that overrides [method _deserialize] returns through it, and a [Serde] with neither an override nor a native implementation ignores the call.

method.name: serialize
method.description: Converts this resource to a [PackedByteArray]. A subclass that overrides [method _serialize] returns through it, and a [Serde] with neither an override nor a native implementation returns an empty array.
